intro: GLab Enterprise (GLab Ent.) is an independent technology and engineering enterprise. It develops practical software and engineering solutions, serves as their business identity, and publishes technical knowledge, guided by environmental responsibility.

Its work spans software, network operations, broadband infrastructure, cybersecurity and digital systems. An environmentalist outlook shapes how problems are framed and solutions are built: considering local conditions, resource use, durability, repair and the wider effects of technology on people and nature. GLabNetOps is one network-operations product initiative; products, projects and publications are documented separately.

This is the official enterprise website: products, engineering projects, technical capabilities, and business enquiries lead. Technical articles, implementation notes, and research-led learning records are maintained separately in Publications.
